punchline: Eckhart Tolle muttered 'I hope I don't end up like her' about a stranger, then realised he had said it aloud.
thirty_sec: A woman argued with an empty seat on the tube, and student Eckhart Tolle followed her all the way to the university library. In the men's room he mumbled that he hoped never to end up like her, then heard himself and saw that his own mind ran just as constantly, only silently. For a moment he stepped back from it, looked in the mirror and laughed.
